body: Ray — confirming the Spotlight Room set Saturday. Load-in 8pm, downbeat at 9. Bring the Real Book.
Got it. I'll be there by 7:45 to warm up the piano.
Claire — can you run payroll Friday and email the recital flyer to the parent list? Thanks!
On it. Flyer goes out tomorrow morning and payroll is queued for Friday.
Tomoko — Phoenix gig is locked for Dec 5, 9pm sharp. Soundcheck at 7. See you there.
Luke — setlist for Friday is in the group thread. Two new tunes, charts attached. Look them over before rehearsal.
Can you grab Dante after practice Thursday? I'm stuck late at Summit.
Yes, I've got Dante Thursday. I'll drop Sofia at choir after and feed them both. Talk soon.
